jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story / brand mascot app icon foreground. Create ONE exquisite new painted foreground asset for the Estudário Android app icon, TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Image 1 is the established Folha identity and open-book silhouette, not a drawing to merely trace. Image 2 gives the approved ink, gouache and colored-pencil painting language, not its flag, props, environment or badge. Design a memorable, professionally art-directed companion that a student will happily see every day. A dimensional gently OPEN indigo hardcover BOOK, two broad softly curved warm cream INNER pages, clearly defined central gutter, thin paper layers at the edges, a compact elegant indigo graduation cap with ONE small golden tassel, ONE mint bookmark draped naturally from the upper gutter down one page. The face belongs entirely on the two broad inner page planes: TWO large clear dark-indigo expressive eyes with small warm highlights, subtle peach cheeks, a confident affectionate small open smile. Near-front three-quarter angle of just a few degrees, coherent entire book tilted slightly, expressive but calm. Exactly TWO very SHORT indigo arms emerging from BEHIND the OUTERMOST LEFT and RIGHT hardcover contours at middle height. The cover overlaps and hides each proximal root; only the tiny forearm segments outside the body silhouette and their TWO small cream mitten hands are seen. Both hands stay close to their own sides in a welcoming relaxed gesture; no raised long V arms, no hand on the face, no rounded socket on a page. No legs or feet. Entire cap, book, arms, hands and short bookmark must be included, with generous transparent margin and no crop. Carefully sculpted painted light, deep indigo shadows and warm cream highlights, tactile grain, decisive economical ink contours. Simplify secondary details for excellent recognition at 48 pixels; strong bold coherent silhouette, spacious eyes, no tiny narrative props. This is the premium daily APP ICON identity, NOT an achievement medal: no wreath, no ring, no frame, no ribbons, no gemstones, no sticker-white stroke, no stars, no confetti, no scenery, no cast shadow outside the character, no text/letters/numerals/watermark, no plastic 3D. Render as a square high-resolution transparent PNG cutout, one single character only.

Use case: illustration-story, high-end educational app campaign background. ONE NEW panoramic illustration for Estudário, with a LANDSCAPE 2.048:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 by 1000 pixels. Image 1 references only the beautiful layered ink/gouache/colored-pencil material quality and sophisticated light, NOT its book character, bronze ring or room. Scene: an imaginative tactile world made of softly folded cream and mint paper, transforming a complicated study syllabus into a clear ascending paper pathway. A restrained beautiful deep INDIGO-to-VIOLET atmosphere (#20164F, #4131A4) with tiny pigment grain and carefully layered depth, vivid MINT (#7EE0B8) edges and small warm amber light accents (#F6C550). The path starts gently at the LOWER LEFT, curves into a luminous sweeping S and climbs through generous sculpted paper terraces on the RIGHT half. Abstract cream paper cards, one small mint checkmark tile and one elegantly folded tab evoke study planning and learning; keep these three props small and never clutter the scene. A soft amber dawn glow behind the right-center terraces, atmospheric indigo layers in the distance, a fine sweeping mint paper ribbon gives a distinctive memorable silhouette. LEFT 55 PERCENT remains QUIET and low-contrast dark indigo negative space for later typography. RIGHT center around x76%,y53% has an inviting clear platform where a separate book mascot will later be composited, but DO NOT DRAW ANY CHARACTER. Composition is intentionally designed for this horizontal canvas, with all meaningful details inside a central 85 percent safe area. Rich handmade editorial painting, premium adult educational brand, elegant sense of wonder and momentum. No library of repetitive tiny books, no generic cosmic nebula, no stock-photo student, no glass UI, no device/phone, no stars or awards, no noisy particles, no borders, no achievement medal, no cropped gigantic objects. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, pseudo-writing or watermark anywhere. Opaque full-bleed background, one single wide scene.
